title: C11 Witness3 Real Gatekeeper Verdict — First Genuine Reconciliation Call

rootCauseFixed.summary: Broker credential retrieval used `-Command -` (stdin), which Windows PowerShell 5.1's console host executes multi-line input line-by-line rather than as one script. Any multi-line brace block silently produced empty stdout, exit 0, indistinguishable from an absent credential. Fixed by switching to `-EncodedCommand` (UTF-16LE + base64), which parses as one complete script. Diagnosed and verified using a synthetic non-secret test credential only — the real credential value was never inspected, printed, or logged.

actualVerdict.reviewerReason: The degraded-mode grant and single consumed work item are evidenced, but the only account of implementation is an explicitly writable working-tree summary. There is no immutable subject-commit diff, file-level change evidence, test/validation results, or reconciliation record tying the completed work to subject b6635fcb4aec96af47a7a5bd16321520941a722c. The review debt therefore cannot be discharged safely.
actualVerdict.reviewerAsks: Provide reconciliation evidence for the already-executed work: the exact diff attributable to subject b6635fcb4aec96af47a7a5bd16321520941a722c, affected-file and behavior summary, validation/test commands with results, and confirmation that GKWORK-9f964bf843f9a840 was the sole work item under the grant. Then resubmit the degraded-mode reconciliation request.

applied: Exactly as returned. Debt stands. No retry attempted, per authorization scope (no retry for a preferred verdict).
